tasks.label: install release
args: $apk = Get-ChildItem '${workspaceFolder}/app/build/outputs/apk/release' -Filter '*-release-local.apk' | Select-Object -First 1; if ($null -eq $apk) { throw 'Signed release APK not found. Configure the release keystore properties before installing.' }; adb -s '${input:androidDevice}' install -r $apk.FullName; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }

tasks.label: install release debug
args: $apk = Get-ChildItem '${workspaceFolder}/app/build/outputs/apk/releaseDebug' -Filter '*-releaseDebug.apk' | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1; if ($null -eq $apk) { throw 'Release debug APK was not found. Run the build release debug task first.' }; adb -s '${input:androidDevice}' install -r $apk.FullName; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
